title: Rectangular bar
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and a translation vector of zero, zero, and zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a single loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (zero, zero) and ends at (zero point zero zero five five, zero). The second line starts at (zero point zero zero five five, zero) and ends at (zero point zero zero five five, zero point zero four zero nine). The third line starts at (zero point zero zero five five, zero point zero four zero nine) and ends at (zero, zero point zero four zero nine). The fourth line completes the loop by starting at (zero, zero point zero four zero nine) and ending at the origin (zero, zero). Apply a scale factor of zero point zero four zero nine to the sketch to adjust its size. Transform the two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the previously set Euler angles and translating it using the translation vector. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by zero point seven five units without extruding in the opposite direction, creating a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar are length zero point zero zero five four five four five four five four five four five four units, width zero point zero four zero nine zero nine zero nine zero nine zero nine one six units, and height zero point seven five units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0055, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0055, 0.0409) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0409) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles (-90, 0, -90) correspond to a rotation of 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
# The translation vector is [0, 0, 0], so no translation is needed
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0055, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0055, 0.0409) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0409) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90.0, 0.0, -90.0) and the translation vector is (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)
